project.description: Reproduces silent loss of cross-module collection contributions. m1's factory injects List<Contrib> with no provider visible at compile time, a soft dependency that emits no requiresBeans entry, so module wiring has no edge between m1 and m2 (which provides a Contrib bean) and they wire in classpath order. The tests module depends on m1 before m2, m1 wires first, and builder.list(Contrib.class) misses m2's bean with no error or warning. Reversing the dependency order, or @InjectModule(requires = Contrib.class) on m1, wires correctly. A bean supplied via BeanScope.builder().bean(...) always appears, masking the dropped module contribution.
